xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4268: Route composer and pan tell input to the main agent: read Claude Code's agent selector instead of guessing

plan.title: Route composer and pan tell input to the main agent: read Claude Code's agent selector instead of guessing
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: PAN-4247's composer notice ('Background subagent … is running. Claude Code may route typed messages to it.') is a guess, and it confused the operator while messages were in fact reaching the main agent. Claude Code's own agent selector (● on the row that receives typed input) is what decides routing; input landed in an already-completed subagent earlier the same day, so 'a subagent is running' is neither necessary nor sufficient. Composer sends and pan tell also paste blindly, so input can still go to a subagent.
narratives.Proposal: Parse the selector from the pane (fixture-tested against Claude Code 2.1.280 captures), and before every composer send and every messageAgent delivery to a claude-code target run a closed-loop ensure-main that presses only Down/Up/Enter/Escape to put ● back on main, re-reading after every key, and refuses loudly (HTTP 409 input-target-not-main; pan tell exit 1 with the message mail-queued) when the switch cannot be confirmed. Expose inputTarget ('main' | { subagent } | 'unknown') on conversation list rows and single reads, and show a composer notice only when the selector is on a subagent, with a Send to main button. Full detail and the probe captures: .pan/drafts/PAN-4268.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing deliverAgentMessage or any kickoff/resume/fork delivery path
- A switch-only button or any control that sends input to a subagent on purpose
- Notices or inputTarget for agent-backed panels (agentId set)
- Non-claude-code harnesses
- A cross-process lock around pane keystrokes
- Removing PAN-4247's sidechain landing probe, 'Delivered to subagent' bubble relabel, or landedInSubagent handling
- Sending any key other than Up, Down, Enter, Escape to a pane (never x, Left, printable text or C-c)
- Updating the OKF bundle (../overdeck-knowledge)
- Pinning a Claude Code version in the repo

metadata.sizeJustification: One issue whose acceptance criteria require all of it: the detector, the switch, both delivery doors (composer route and messageAgent/pan tell), the read-model field and the composer notice that consumes it. The code touches three source trees (src/lib, src/cli, src/dashboard); the projected count exceeds 6 subsystems only because each doc file (docs/CONVERSATION-SUBAGENTS.md, docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md) and the pan-tell skill count separately, and it exceeds 25 files only because 10 entries are tests or the single fixture glob. Splitting the notice into a sibling issue would ship a read-model field nothing consumes, or keep the hedged notice the issue asks to remove.

autoDecisions.summary: Ensure-main is a new helper in src/lib/agents/input-target.ts called from the composer route and messageAgent only, not from deliverAgentMessage.
autoDecisions.rationale: Kickoff, resume and fork deliveries never have subagents, and delivery.ts is already at its allowlisted size ceiling (1119 lines).

autoDecisions.summary: A selector whose layout cannot be parsed ('unknown') refuses the send.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue forbids silent misrouting; an unreadable selector is exactly the case the fixture tests exist to catch.

autoDecisions.summary: Pane I/O follows the pane: Herdr only when Herdr holds a pane for the agent, otherwise tmux capture-pane/send-keys (the same fallback deliverAgentMessage takes); only a throwing read of a resolved pane refuses.
autoDecisions.rationale: On a Herdr host deliverAgentMessage falls through to the supervisor/tmux cascade for agents Herdr does not hold, so refusing on 'herdr holds no pane' would block deliveries that succeed today.

autoDecisions.summary: No selector rows on screen means input goes to main and no keys are sent.
autoDecisions.rationale: The live probe showed Claude Code hides the selector when no agents are listed, and typed input then reaches main.

autoDecisions.summary: The switch uses only Down/Up/Enter/Escape in a verified closed loop (Down until a footer cursor appears, move the cursor to main, Enter, Escape, re-read after every key).
autoDecisions.rationale: The probe showed Escape alone never returns to main, Left opens the fleet view, the first Down is not deterministic, and typed text or 'x' with footer focus is swallowed or stops a subagent.

autoDecisions.summary: PAN-4247's hedged 'running' notice, evidence-based 'routed' notice and its Send anyway / Wait gate are removed; the bubble relabel and landedInSubagent handling stay.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks to remove the hedged notice and warn only on the selector; the confirm gate guarded against re-routing, which the default switch now prevents.

autoDecisions.summary: 'Send to main' submits the current draft through the normal send path and is disabled on an empty draft; there is no switch-only button.
autoDecisions.rationale: Every send already switches to main; the issue's AC is 'switches, confirms and sends'.

autoDecisions.summary: Agent-backed panels (agentId set) show no notice; their sends still switch through messageAgent.
autoDecisions.rationale: inputTarget lives on conversation list rows, and agents are not in that list; adding it to the agent read model is scope the issue does not ask for.

autoDecisions.summary: Refusals answer HTTP 409 with code 'input-target-not-main', deliveryUnknown false, retryable true.
autoDecisions.rationale: composerSend.ts turns that into 'Failed to send message (409): <reason>', the editor keeps the draft (cleared only on success) and the failed-message outbox offers Retry.

autoDecisions.summary: inputTarget is read in conversation list enrichment and getConversationRead, only for live claude-code conversations with a subagents/ directory.
autoDecisions.rationale: That is the existing liveness cadence (2 s TTL, 10 s client poll) and the gate avoids pane reads for sessions that cannot show a selector.

autoDecisions.summary: Fixtures live in src/lib/agents/__fixtures__/claude-code-2.1.280/, named by the captured version.
autoDecisions.rationale: The repo pins no Claude Code version; 2.1.280 is the installed version the probe captured.

autoDecisions.summary: The live end-to-end check (composer and pan tell landing in the main JSONL) is a test-role UAT criterion plus a work-agent checkpoint in a throwaway tmux socket.
autoDecisions.rationale: It needs a real Claude Code session with a background subagent, which unit tests cannot provide, and live Overdeck panes must never receive probe keystrokes.

items.title: Parse Claude Code's agent selector from a pane screen

narrative.Action: PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-4268.md work item W1. Create src/lib/agents/input-target.ts exporting SelectorRow, SelectorState, InputTarget ('main' | { subagent: string } | 'unknown'), parseAgentSelector(screen) and inputTargetFromSelector(state), exactly as the PRD's W1 types and parsing rules state: strip ANSI, trimEnd lines, scan only lines after the LAST /^─+$/ bottom rule, row regex /^(❯ | {2})([●◯⏺]) (.+)$/, label split on /\s{2,}/ with ' (+N)' group count, prompt text between top and bottom rule with 'Message @<type>…' treated as empty, footerHint from 'to select · Enter to view' / 'Enter to view', and fleetView when a line after the bottom rule contains 'enter to return'. Derivation: fleetView → 'unknown'; no rows → 'main'; no main row or filledCount !== 1 → 'unknown'; filled main → 'main'; else { subagent: description }. Create the nine fixture files under src/lib/agents/__fixtures__/claude-code-2.1.280/ — four copied verbatim from the PRD's 'Captured screens' section (main-selected, footer-focused-main, footer-focused-subagent, subagent-selected) plus no-subagents, several-subagents, garbled, transcript-bullets-only and fleet-view (verbatim from the PRD) built as the PRD W1 step 1 describes. Write input-target-parser.test.ts covering the PRD's fixture table.

narrative.Action: PRD work item W3. Add EnsureMainDeps { io, sleep }, EnsureMainResult and ensureMainInputTarget(agentId, deps?) to src/lib/agents/input-target.ts. Default io = resolveAgentPaneIo (W2), resolved ONCE per call so reads and keys hit the same pane (a throw while resolving refuses like a read failure); default sleep = setTimeout promise. Follow the PRD's numbered procedure exactly: read (throw → refuse 'Could not read…'); fleetView → one Escape, settle, still fleet → refuse; no rows → ok 'no-selector'; 'unknown' → refuse; filled main with no cursor → ok 'already-main'; subagent filled with non-empty promptText and no cursor → refuse; press Down up to 4 times until a cursor row appears; move the cursor with Up/Down until it is on main (max rows.length + 1 moves); Enter and settle until filledIndex === mainIndex; Escape and settle until cursorIndex === null; final check ● on main and no cursor. Settle = poll every SELECTOR_POLL_MS = 150 up to SELECTOR_SETTLE_TIMEOUT_MS = 1500. Only Up, Down, Enter, Escape are ever sent. Use the PRD's refusal texts verbatim. Tests use a scripted fake pane built from the W1 fixtures and a no-op sleep (never real timers), including the observed path where the first Down lands the cursor on main. Then do the PRD's live implementation checkpoint in a THROWAWAY tmux socket (tmux -L pan4268verify) with an uncommitted script passing explicit io deps — never against a live Overdeck agent or conversation pane — and record the outcome (including whether Down enters the footer while main is mid-turn) in the commit message; fallback per the PRD is the bounded refusal.
